cards.answer: Olaf is a fighter who gains attack speed and life steal as his health falls, favoring sustained attacks. His damage includes physical and true damage, with AD scaling; Ragnarok grants crowd control immunity that he can extend by attacking champions. Avoid extended close combat and create distance during Ragnarok.
cards.counterplay: Avoid extended close combat and create distance during Ragnarok.

cards.answer: Undertow throws an axe through enemies, dealing physical damage and slowing them; champions hit also lose armor temporarily. Picking up the axe reduces its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the axe and avoid retreating along his axe pickup path.

cards.answer: Tough It Out temporarily grants attack speed and a shield that grows with Olaf's missing health, up to a cap. It also resets his basic attack timer.
cards.counterplay: Create space during the attack speed boost and avoid committing damage into his shield.

cards.answer: Reckless Swing spends Olaf's health to deal true damage to a target, refunding the health cost if it kills the target. Basic attacks reduce its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Limit his opportunities to stay close and keep basic attacking.

cards.answer: Ragnarok passively grants armor and magic resistance. Activating it cleanses crowd control, grants crowd control immunity and bonus attack damage, and briefly boosts movement speed toward nearby visible enemy champions. Basic attacks and Reckless Swing against champions extend its duration.
cards.counterplay: Create distance during Ragnarok and save crowd control for after it ends.
